title: Account Deletion
content:
PetStore Kenya Account Deletion

If you have a PetStore Kenya app or website account, you can request deletion of your account and associated personal data.

How to delete your account

Option 1: Delete your account yourself

  1. Log in to your PetStore Kenya account.
  2. Visit this page while logged in.
  3. Click the Delete Account button below.
  4. Confirm the deletion request.

Option 2: Request deletion by email

If you cannot log in, email customercare@petstore.co.ke from your registered email address with the subject:

Delete my PetStore Kenya account

Please include:

  • Your full name
  • Your registered email address
  • Your registered phone number

What will be deleted

When your account is deleted, PetStore Kenya will remove:

  • Your app and website account profile
  • Your saved account details
  • Saved addresses linked to your account
  • App login/session data
  • Push notification tokens linked to your account
  • App preferences linked to your account

What may be retained

Some information may be retained where required for legal, tax, payment, delivery, fraud-prevention, customer support, or accounting purposes.

This may include:

  • Order records
  • Payment records
  • Delivery records
  • Invoice or tax records
  • Refund or dispute records

These records are retained only where required for legitimate business or legal purposes.

Processing time

Account deletion requests are processed within 30 days.

Contact

For help with account deletion, contact:

customercare@petstore.co.ke
